result.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, blacklistedGuestEmails are lowercased (`email.toLowerCase()`) but the check `blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` uses the raw guest string without lowercasing, and duplicate filtering uses strict equality (`guest === attendee.email`). So 'Admin@evil.com' or 'User@Example.com' bypasses both blacklist and duplicate checks — a real correctness/security defect introduced by the diff.
